nodes.label: Bar (M3 floating pill panel)
nodes.rationale: Floating pill with corner-full radius; visible:!ShellState.barHidden unmaps the panel so the exclusive zone is released and windows reclaim the space.

nodes.label: Battery (UPower chip)
nodes.rationale: errorContainer fill when critically low (<=15% and not charging); primary tint while plugged in.

nodes.label: IconButton (M3 chip control base)
nodes.rationale: Wheel handling lives in the MouseArea rather than a sibling WheelHandler so they cannot race; mouse notches are one step, touchpad pixelDelta is accumulated into ~60px steps. Press morphs corners md<->sm with an OutBack spring.

nodes.label: StateLayer (M3 hover/press overlay)
nodes.rationale: Transient overlay on top of the parent container color; follows the parent's corner radius even while it morphs.

nodes.label: SystemMonitor (CPU/GPU/RAM/network poller)
nodes.rationale: Named SystemMonitor (not SystemStats) so import "../services" does not shadow the modules/SystemStats bar chip. Native port of ~/.config/waybar/scripts/waybar-system.sh: CPU/network use two /proc samples 100ms apart for deltas.

nodes.label: Theme (M3 Expressive design tokens singleton)
nodes.rationale: Colors are generated by matugen (SchemeExpressive) from the wallpaper into style/Colors.json; FileView watches the file so matugen image ... recolors the bar live without a reload, and the Material baseline dark scheme is the fallback when it is absent.

nodes.label: Material 3 Expressive design language
nodes.rationale: Shape scale, state layers (8%/10%), emphasized easing curves and tonals follow the M3 Expressive spec so every surface shares one visual language.

nodes.label: matugen dynamic color scheme
nodes.rationale: Wallpaper-driven SchemeExpressive palette written to style/Colors.json; matugen emits 6-digit hex but 8-digit RRGGBBAA is tolerated and reordered for QML AARRGGBB.

nodes.label: LayoutBadge (keyboard-layout HUD)
nodes.rationale: Fully click- and keyboard-transparent (mask: Region {}) and mapped only while shown; follows Niri.keyboardLayouts.currentIdx directly so rapid switches re-target the highlight without replaying the pop-in.

nodes.label: Niri (niri IPC bridge singleton)
nodes.rationale: Live state from niri msg event-stream plus one-shot queries for initial state; the stream is respawned 1s after exit.

nodes.label: ShellState (cross-window state singleton)
nodes.rationale: Overlay ownership is stored as a screen-name string (empty = closed) so niri keybinds can pass the focused output to qs ipc call launcher/clipboard toggleOn.

nodes.label: Waybar-era shell migration
nodes.rationale: The bar rebuilds the previous Waybar setup natively: waybar-system.sh -> SystemMonitor, wofi --show drun -> Launcher, wlogout -> PowerMenu, waybar niri/language formats -> Niri.layoutShortName.

nodes.label: ClipboardLauncher (cliphist overlay)
nodes.rationale: decode/delete take one cliphist list line on stdin; the line is passed as an argument so its text is never interpreted by the shell. Same visual language as the app launcher.

nodes.label: Launcher (app launcher overlay, wofi replacement)
nodes.rationale: Replaces wofi --show drun. Matching is exact > prefix > word start > substring > subsequence; lower-weight fields need a stronger match so a comment hit cannot outrank a name hit. Results are computed only while visible.

nodes.label: graphify Knowledge Graph Workflow
nodes.rationale: Answers come from a scoped graph query; dirty graphify-out files are expected after hooks, and graph.json is rewritten whole on every build so large diffs are not churn.

nodes.label: graphify update After Code Changes
nodes.rationale: AST-only incremental update keeps the graph current with no API cost.

nodes.label: Query Graph Before grep or File Reads
nodes.norm_label: query graph before grep or file reads
nodes.rationale: query/path/explain return a scoped subgraph usually much smaller than GRAPH_REPORT.md or raw grep output.
